name: Doctrine Feature
summary: Hold Doctrine Feature Hearthguard Your damage reduction becomes 2. Ironhead Your attacks against objects, vehicles, and machines deal +1d8 damage. Guild-Militant When an ally hits your Oath-Mark target, you may use your reaction to let that ally add +1d6 damage.
